name: Why does my bathroom sink have a foul odor, and can repair fix it?

mainEntity.name: Why does my bathroom sink have a foul odor, and can repair fix it?

acceptedAnswer.text: A foul odor from your bathroom sink usually indicates a problem within the drain system. This can be caused by bacteria and mold growth in the P-trap (the U-shaped pipe under the sink) due to stagnant water and accumulated debris like hair and soap scum. Sometimes, it can also be a sign of a dry P-trap if the sink isn't used often, allowing sewer gases to escape. A repair involves thoroughly cleaning the P-trap and drain lines, or if necessary, inspecting the vent pipe system for proper function. Ensuring the P-trap always contains water by regular use or running water for a minute can help prevent dry traps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Foul odors from a bathroom sink often stem from bacteria and debris in the P-trap or a dry P-trap allowing sewer gases. Cleaning or checking the vent pipe can fix it.
